## Peltast Troop (CR 8)

Wielding javelins and various light weapons, these nimble fighters weave and dart through any cover they can find across the battlefield while harrying their foes.  

**XP** 4,800  
N Medium humanoid (human, troop)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** Perception +18  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 15, flat-footed 17 (+7 armor, +4 Dex, +1 dodge)  
**hp** 104 (11d8+50)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +11, **Will** +7  
**Defensive Abilities** troop traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** troop (2d6+5)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** skirmishers  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 19, **Con** 19, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 13  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +13; **CMD** 27  
**Feats** Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Mobility, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness  
**Skills** Knowledge (local, nature) +8, Perception +18, Stealth +6  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** favored enemy, skirmishers  


**Special Abilities**



**Favored Enemy (Ex)** Peltasts spend their training studying the techniques of a specific enemy, often a foreign country and its armies rather than a creature type or subtype, and specifically learning how to defeat its troops in their homeland. This training and hatred grant the peltast troop a +2 bonus on Perception checks, troop melee damage, and damage rolls when facing other troop units. Their training also grants the peltasts a +3 bonus on all Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (nature) checks. The bonuses on Knowledge checks are calculated into the troop’s stat block.  

**Skirmish (Ex)** Peltasts are effective and versatile hit-and-run troops.
